description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface, providing ways to configure and add AdoNet-based grain directory services within Orleans hosting setup.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectorySiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure AdoNet grain directory services.

methods.name: UseAdoNetGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use AdoNet grain directory as the default, with options configured via a delegate.

methods.name: UseAdoNetGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Overload that configures the silo builder to use AdoNet grain directory as default, with options configured via OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory
methods.description: Adds an AdoNet grain directory with a specified name and configuration options.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory
methods.description: Overload that adds an AdoNet grain directory with a specified name and options configured via OptionsBuilder.
